name: mangos-revocation-tests-only
instr:
Add outbound message tags and revocation receipts. Preserve existing behaviour.

SetRevocationID accepts nonzero uint64 values, including the maximum, and RevocationID returns the tag. Zero returns ErrInvalidRevocationID, leaves an untagged message at zero and permits a later valid set. Dup and MakeUnique preserve tags and give independently mutable header/body storage; their pending copies remain revocable.

Receipts identify the requested tag. Unknown tags return RevocationUnknown with Removed=0 on BUS, PAIRv1, PUB, PUSH, STAR and raw BUS/PUB/PUSH. Unknown PUSH revocation leaves known pending work removable.

Pending PAIRv1 and cooked/raw PUSH revocation returns RevocationRemoved with Removed=1. Removing a middle PAIRv1 or raw PUSH item leaves both neighbors individually removable. After peer delivery, PAIRv1/PUSH return RevocationDispatched with Removed=0. Tagged PUSH bodies equal equivalent untagged bodies across transport.

Queued raw BUS fan-out revocation removes both copies, reports Removed=2 and prevents their delivery while preserving preceding traffic. Raw PUB revocation removes its pending publication, preserves surrounding untagged payloads/order and prevents revoked delivery. SUB filtering continues to accept matching prefixes. Raw STAR revocation removes locally originated work while preserving equal-tag peer traffic.

SUB returns RevocationUnsupported with Removed=0 and preserves subscription delivery order. Closing BUS/PAIRv1/PUSH/STAR before revocation retur
